1. @Test public void testEmptyByteArray() {
    byte[] input = {};
    String expected = "";
    Assert.assertEquals(expected, Base64.encodeBase64String(input));
}

2. @Test public void testSingleByteArray() {
    byte[] input = {0};
    String expected = "Mw==";
    Assert.assertEquals(expected, Base64.encodeBase64String(input));
}

3. @Test public void testMultiByteArray() {
    byte[] input = {1, 2, 3};
    String expected = "MTIz";
    Assert.assertEquals(expected, Base64.encodeBase64String(input));
}
